metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2025 · Dexter: Resurrection
metas.description: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Dept. Q
metas.description: Carl, a former top-rated detective, is wracked with guilt following an attack that left his partner paralyzed and another policeman dead. On his return to work, Carl is assigned to a cold case that will consume his life.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · His & Hers
metas.description: A journalist investigating a murder in her hometown clashes with a suspicious detective. There are two sides to every story, and someone is lying.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Widow's Bay
metas.description: A skeptical mayor leads the superstitious residents of a cursed New England island.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · The Beast in Me
metas.description: Author Aggie Wiggs, grieving the loss of her son, finds new purpose unraveling the mystery behind neighbor Nile Jarvis' vanished wife and his suspicious dealings.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Untamed
metas.description: In the vast expanse of Yosemite National Park, a woman's death draws a federal agent into lawless terrain, where nature obeys no rules but its own.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · I Will Find You
metas.description: A father imprisoned for his son's murder receives evidence suggesting his child may be alive, compelling him to escape and uncover the truth.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Black Rabbit
metas.description: When the owner of a New York City hotspot allows his turbulent brother back in his life, he opens the door to escalating dangers that threaten to bring down everything he's built.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · All Her Fault
metas.description: When her son vanishes after a play date at the park, a mother is thrust into a desperate search to uncover the truth behind his disappearance.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Ekaki
metas.description: A group of friends plan a fun weekend getaway to the mysterious Ekaki Villa, only to find themselves caught between laughter and fear when strange haunting begin. Filled with hilarious chaos, spooky twists, and emotional moments

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2025 · Wayward
metas.description: A bucolic but sinister town explores the insidious intricacies of the troubled teen industry, and the eternal struggle of the next generation.
